title: Identify vs. Write Thesis
instructions: Read the prompt. Choose which statement is a strong thesis. Then write your own.
instructions_es: Lee el prompt. Elige cuál es una tesis fuerte. Luego escribe la tuya.
prompt:
Topic: Social media's effect on teen mental health.

(A) Social media is popular.
(B) While social media offers connection, excessive use correlates with depression and anxiety in teens, requiring parental and platform oversight.

Which is stronger?

title: Debatable Thesis Challenge
instructions: Write a debatable thesis on the given topic. Must be arguable, not obvious fact.
instructions_es: Escribe una tesis debatible sobre el tema dado. Debe ser argumentable, no un hecho obvio.
prompt: Should remote work be the default for white-collar jobs post-pandemic?

title: Integrate a Quote
instructions: Integrate the quote into a complete sentence. Use signal phrase + quote + explanation.
instructions_es: Integra la cita en una oración completa. Usa frase introductoria + cita + explicación.
prompt:
Quote: 'The internet has democratized access to information.'

Write a sentence that introduces, quotes, and explains this idea.

title: Build a Rebuttal
instructions: Given an opposing viewpoint, write a strong rebuttal block. Acknowledge the counterpoint, then refute it with evidence.
instructions_es: Dado un punto de vista opuesto, escribe un bloque de refutación fuerte. Reconoce el contraargumento, luego refútalo con evidencia.
prompt:
Counterargument: 'Artificial intelligence will eliminate jobs, not create them.'

Write a 150-200 word rebuttal acknowledging the concern but arguing why AI creates net job growth.

title: Narrow Your Research Question
instructions: Given a broad topic, write 2-3 narrow, specific research questions.
instructions_es: Dado un tema amplio, escribe 2-3 preguntas de investigación estrechas y específicas.
prompt:
Broad topic: Climate Change

Create focused research questions (not 'What is climate change?' but narrower angles).

title: CRAAP Criteria Check
instructions: Evaluate a source using CRAAP (Currency, Relevance, Authority, Accuracy, Purpose). Rate each dimension.
instructions_es: Evalúa una fuente usando CRAAP. Califica cada dimensión.
prompt:
Source: A 2019 blog post on health trends by an anonymous writer, republished on a wellness site with ads.

Rate: Currency, Relevance, Authority, Accuracy, Purpose. Would you cite this in a research paper?

title: Identify & Fix Agreement Errors
title_es: Identifica y Corrige Errores de Concordancia
instructions: Identify subject-verb agreement errors and correct them.
instructions_es: Identifica errores de concordancia sujeto-verbo y corrígelos.
prompt:
1. 'The team are playing well.'
2. 'Economics are a complex subject.'
3. 'Everyone in the classes have participated.'

Which sentences have errors? Fix them.

title: APA Citation Format
instructions: Create correct APA citations for the given sources.
instructions_es: Crea citas APA correctas para las fuentes dadas.
prompt:
Source 1: Book by Smith (2020) titled 'Digital Futures'
Source 2: Journal article by Johnson & Lee (2021) in 'Tech Review' vol 15, pp 45-62

Format both in APA style.

title: Paraphrase vs. Quote
instructions: Paraphrase the following text without changing meaning. Then explain when you'd quote vs. paraphrase.
instructions_es: Parafrasa el siguiente texto sin cambiar su significado. Luego explica cuándo citar vs parafrasear.
prompt:
Original: 'The rapid expansion of artificial intelligence has outpaced regulatory frameworks, creating ethical dilemmas around data privacy and algorithmic bias.'

Your paraphrase + decision: quote or paraphrase? Why?

title: Grammar Sprint (3 min)
instructions: Fix all grammar, punctuation, and clarity errors in this paragraph. You have 3 minutes!
instructions_es: ¡Corrige todos los errores de gramática, puntuación y claridad en este párrafo. ¡Tienes 3 minutos!
prompt: The students was struggling with they're assignments, and the teachers recommend that everyone submit there work on time. Each student need to proofread they're documents careful before turning it in.
